notes: Ye shall have is placed under rule 43: הָיָה stands in the clause and takes the have, the possessive לְ goes unrepresented under rule 40, and the suffix takes the English subject pronoun.

The two supplied fors are given to their nouns, each comparative כְּ already holding an English word of its own; the alternative reads as well for and as for as the prepositions' whole renderings. Marking them added is not available, since a relational word is licensed here.
The second יִהְיֶה is unrepresented under rule 22, the ASV writing one shall have for the sentence.
